description: This file defines the Configuration class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for the STS (Security Token Service) Regional Endpoints feature. It manages the configuration for endpoint types ('legacy' or 'regional') and whether fallback is enabled.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Class that manages the configuration of regional endpoint settings for AWS STS client.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoints type and fallback option, validating the endpoint type.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.

methods.name: isFallback
methods.description: Indicates whether fallback mode is enabled.
